facts.1. First contracted caravan is scheduled: 30; the caravan arrived on schedule. Its papers, identities, declared cargo class, and visible load remained consistent. Tang Wei personally inspected the routine gate line between 10:35 and 11:30 and found no discrepancy requiring a hold or personal intervention.
facts.2. Sword Manor Commander Wei Jian reques: 00 command council; its provisional posture remains to honor existing escort obligations and avoid fresh trainee reallocation pending principal direction.
facts.adjacent_security: Both Tang Champion companies are assigned to Tang Wei's personal protection and are physically at Tang Manor: Duan Jin commands First Company and Shen Rui commands Second Company. Tang Kai has zero assigned troops.
available_reports_already_delivered: Kanyou intelligence case opened with Tang Ling; inner contents known to Tang Wei and Tang Ling
Main Gate routine inspection personally confirmed by Tang Wei
Wei Jian command counsel delivered directly

Tang Ling partial Qin inquiry reply delivered at 12:25: Duke Hyou is an active Qin great general but has no current army or unit assignment in the accessible command record; no confirmed placement route was found; Tang Wei's private units require separate Qin acceptance and assignment; officer-test and accepting-command answers remained pending

At 15:15:48 a public Qin military-administration inquiry identified Ouki's command staff channel as a lawful referral route for officer-entry or command review because Ouki is a registered Qin great general with army-or-unit command scope. Ouki's physical location remains unresolved; no appointment, audience, or private-unit acceptance was granted

At 16:30:48 a second public registry cross-check identified Mou Bu's registered Qin command staff as another lawful senior-command referral route for officer-entry or command review. Mou Bu's physical location remains unresolved; no appointment, audience, or private-unit acceptance was granted

At 17:15:48 Qin military clerks clarified the public intake requirements for both referrals: an outsider can submit identity and status, the service or command sought, and evidence of prior command responsibility or qualification for staff review. House Tang command experience may be submitted as evidence but creates no Qin rank. Any further examination or probation is set by the receiving command staff rather than guaranteed by the public registry; actual command still requires authorized appointment and a live vacancy or lawful acting need.

At 17:45:48 a current command-roll check found no certified live officer or field-command vacancy under either Ouki or Mou Bu. Both have registered staff channels, but their command-person records show no current army or unit assignment and their army assignment views currently carry zero assigned personnel. Their staffs can receive review petitions, but the public office cannot promise immediate placement or deployment.

At 18:05:48 Qin military clerks clarified the Duke Hyou-specific route: the Kanyou public military petition intake can register an officer-candidate routing petition addressed to Duke Hyou by name even while his command has no current army or unit assignment. Without a confirmed active command or staff receiving channel, such a filing remains a routing petition rather than direct delivery to Duke Hyou.

At 18:45:48 Tang Wei's officer-entry and field-command consideration packet was accepted into Ouki's registered staff review channel. It identifies Tang Wei and House Tang status, requests field-command consideration, and offers his House Tang command responsibility as evidence. Staff review is pending.

At 19:25:48 an equivalent packet was accepted into Mou Bu's registered staff review channel. It requests field-command consideration and offers the same House Tang command responsibility as evidence. Staff review is pending.

At 21:51:36 Tang Wei compared the Kanyou findings with his mother Tang Ling's separate House Tang inquiry. Her channel had produced no newer reply beyond the 12:25 partial answer. The two information paths agreed: Ouki and Mou Bu have real staff-review channels but no certified current field vacancy; Duke Hyou remained without a confirmed active army or staff receiving route, though a named routing petition could be registered for him.

At 22:51:36 Tang Wei completed preparation of a Duke Hyou-addressed officer-candidate routing petition and ordered it carried to the Kanyou public military intake. At the same time, Tang Ling began a targeted House Tang inquiry into which Qin authority would control Duke Hyou's next mobilization or assign officers when his command becomes active.

At 06:15 on 245-BCE-12-03, the Kanyou public military intake registered Tang Wei's petition under Duke Hyou's name. The Ouki and Mou Bu staff-review packets remained pending, and Tang Ling's targeted mobilization-authority inquiry had no supported answer yet.

At 07:51:36 the House Tang courier returned to Tang Manor with the public military-intake receipt confirming the Duke Hyou-addressed routing petition is registered. All three senior-command routes were formally active, but no Qin appointment or deployment order had been returned.

From 08:00 to 14:00 on 245-BCE-12-03 Tang Wei completed one six-hour deliberate training block under his saved standing routine. The six hours were preserved as verified development evidence; no permanent skill-point award was fabricated without a lawful curriculum allocation and review.

At 06:15 on 245-BCE-12-04 Ouki's registered staff-review channel completed preliminary screening of Tang Wei's petition and issued a substantive request for Tang Wei to present in Kanyou for a preliminary command-qualification review. The notice grants no Qin rank, appointment, certified field vacancy, private-unit acceptance, commander location, or deployment authority.

From 06:15 to 06:30 the dedicated House Tang courier received the sealed Ouki staff notice and completed ordinary ready-party handoff and egress. From 06:30 to 07:22:48 the fit mounted courier used remount support on the maintained 6.4 km Kanyou-Tang Manor road and reached Tang Manor without a recorded loss, injury, route interruption, or information leak. At 07:22:48 the notice was delivered to Tang Wei.
facts.current_decision: At 07:22:48 on 245-BCE-12-04 Tang Wei has the first substantive Qin response in hand: Ouki's staff requests that he present in Kanyou for a preliminary command-qualification review. Mou Bu remains pending; the Duke Hyou routing petition still lacks a confirmed receiving command; Tang Ling's mobilization-authority inquiry remains active.
facts.forbidden_inference: Ouki's review request is an examination/review step, not Qin enlistment, officer rank, field-command appointment, private-unit acceptance, a certified vacancy, commander location, or deployment authority. Mou Bu and Duke Hyou remain unresolved.
facts.immediate_pressure: Tang Wei now has a concrete Ouki qualification-review opportunity before the day's 08:00 standing training opportunity, while the Mou Bu and Duke Hyou paths remain open.
facts.participants: Tang Wei is at Tang Manor as the dedicated Ouki-response courier returns. Tang Ling remains responsible for her targeted Duke Hyou mobilization-authority inquiry. Duan Jin and Shen Rui are at Tang Manor with their respective Tang Champion companies. Tang Kai remains at the manor with zero assigned troops.
